labels.caption: Part grid, development-exposed (continuity, not a confirmation result). (a) The end-to-end week at 4 alignments under the trace lender: cost over all-fallback, the median over the policy seeds with their range; Critical-ratio renting ran policy seed 0 only. Ranges narrower than a marker are hidden by it (the largest is 0.017); every entry is in Table e7v2_grid. (b), (c) The guard study's held-out cells of 4 instances: the median cost under the trace lender and W0, the largest median over the stress lenders; Greedy + one-way guard, Lagged RetroRenting + one-way guard and the lagged RetroRenting-style rule from the guard study's summary (its cells). In every panel the series sit left to right in the legend's order, read down its columns. Criterion S: W0 <= 1.05 on every instance. It holds for Sublet; Greedy + guard; Greedy + one-way guard; Lagged RetroRenting + one-way guard. It fails for Critical-ratio renting; RetroRenting-style, lagged. Criterion T is not computable: part grid runs no renting baseline (BL1, BL2, BL5) on these cells (the guard study's own T for its rows is in Table e7v2_q44).
